assets.alt_text: Citta helps an agent discover capabilities, delegate a task to an available worker, and collect the result. Reasons include private data, installed tools, connected hardware and available compute.
An agent on the Mini asks a worker on the Air to read synthetic receipts. The actual returned expense report identifies a duplicate and a missing receipt.
An agent delegates expense categorization to Gemma 3 4B through Ollama on the Mini. The actual model-result table is shown; inference is local and Codex orchestration is cloud-backed.

Give your agent more capabilities: connect your own computers through Tailscale under the same owner, install Citta and check setup, then ask an available worker to run a small task. Each receiving device needs the required tools, accounts and permissions.
Citta mark: two open concentric arcs in green on a charcoal square.

captions.model: Gemma generated categories and per-expense notes on the Mini. Python supplied amounts and receipt checks. Local inference does not make the whole workflow cloud-free.

Slides 2 and 3 crop actual demo results. No OCR, reimbursement approval or email sending is represented.
